description: Per-character relationship graph row: the visible partner list and the starting/ending relation levels plus the level-definition row id for each partner.

ID.simple: Character id owning the partner list.
ID.technical: FName row key in StoryCharaGraphPairDataTables (DTM +0x870), looked up from character ids throughout the relation UI, from GetCharaRelateLevel, and collected by Story_GetCharaGraphPairIds_1308E80. Exported rows are character codes such as CP_010.

Id_Character.simple: Partner character ids connected to this character.
Id_Character.technical: TArray<FName>, nine slots in the export. Consumers use Find(OtherId) to obtain the parallel-array index for StartRelateLevel/EndRelateLevel/Id_StoryCharaRelateLevel, and iterate all entries to build the relation target list. Several call sites use the resulting index without checking INDEX_NONE.

StartRelateLevel.simple: Initial relation level for each partner.
StartRelateLevel.technical: TArray<int32> parallel to Id_Character. AGameManager::GetCharaRelateLevel converts this level to a starting value via WidgetTest_StoryRelationValue (GlobalThreshold STORY_CHARA_RELATE_LV_1..5), adds the saved directed change (StudioNestedNameInts_770) and converts back with WidgetTest_StoryRelationLevel. The reward-grant flow also uses it as the lower bound for newly claimable reward levels.

EndRelateLevel.simple: Maximum relation level for each partner.
EndRelateLevel.technical: TArray<int32> parallel to Id_Character. GameStoryCharaRelateRewardViewWidget shows level milestones with StartLevel < ItemLevel <= EndLevel; the pair's end level therefore bounds the displayed and claimable relationship reward tiers.

Id_StoryCharaRelateLevel.technical: TArray<FName> parallel to Id_Character. Resolved in StoryCharaRelateLevelDataTables (DTM +0x880) so the UI can read bFriendly[level-1] for the friendly/hostile label and gauge/line visuals; missing rows or out-of-range levels are not guarded in these consumers.

notes: All four arrays are index-parallel; the C++ uses Find(Partner) on Id_Character and immediately indexes the other arrays. A partner absent from Id_Character yields INDEX_NONE in several paths without a guard.

Row constructor is empty (Source/AbramsDataTable/Private/GameDataTableRow_StoryCharaGraphPair.cpp:3). Exported rows have nine partner slots; some EndRelateLevel values are 3 rather than 5 (later partners).

The graph-pair row is both a UI graph definition and the authority for relation level math; relation increments themselves live in GameManager.UserInfo.Story.StudioNestedNameInts_770 (Source/Abrams/Private/GameManagerGraphics.cpp:486-487).

Evidence is from the reconstructed C++ in Source/ (row shape/counts from the exported table); status/ records byte matches for some owner TUs, but this file does not claim a retail byte comparison for every function or exhaustive Blueprint/runtime coverage.

usages.detail: GetCharaRelateLevel combines StartRelateLevel, saved changes and GlobalThreshold conversion.
Builds the relation target list from Id_Character.
Chooses level label and friendly/hostile gauge from the paired StoryCharaRelateLevel row.
Selects friendly/hostile line parameters for the graph edge.
Derives start/end level bounds for reward milestones.
Story_HasNewCharaRelate uses the partner list to find released pairs with new relation content.
